sloka: ततः शोणितदिग्धाङ्गौ लक्ष्मणेन्द्रजितावुभौ।रणे तौ रेजतुर्वीरौ पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ ।। ६.९१.३७ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ śoṇitadigdhāṅgau lakṣmaṇendrajitāvubhau।raṇe tau rejaturvīrau puṣpitāviva kiṁśukau ।। 6.91.37 ।।

translations.english: Both heroes of extraordinary might and equipped with huge arms, endowed with terrific valour, Lakshmana and Indrajith struck one another with sharp arrows.
